How to Upload to GitHub Pages

Ready in less than 2 minutes (100% Free Hosting!)

  1. 1 Create a GitHub Repo: Go to github.com/new, name it e.g. bbgurl-birthday, and keep it Public.
  2. 2 Upload This File: Click "Add file" > "Upload files", drag and drop this index.html, and commit.
  3. 3 Turn On GitHub Pages: Go to Settings > Pages, under "Branch" select main (root), and click Save.
🎉 Your live URL will be: https://<your-username>.github.io/bbgurl-birthday/! You can send that direct link to bbgurl!
